items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: No, I didn't know him. No.

ctx.x: Went to Los Angeles long, about the latter part of the teens, around 18, 17, 18.

Do you remember a group that came up here with Manuel Perez and Lorenzo Teo? Do you remember? No, I didn't remember that. Or another, Tig Chambers, I think, was up here pretty early. Do you remember a cornet player, Tig Chambers?
No, I didn't know him. No. First trumpet players was Freddie Chambers and Tommy Ladner.
